title: malva micans subsp. minoricensis
intro: Malva micans subsp. minoricensis, commonly known as the Minorcan mallow, is a plant species that belongs to the Malvaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Malva micans subsp. minoricensis are attributed to its ability to stimulate bowel movements, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
